reviews.comment: I took the six week online summer course and it was very simple. By completing one assignment per day, there should be no stress. There were no exams, only two projects and daily work. I don't think she actually reads any of your submissions (projects included), and grades by completion. This class should be an easy 100 if you don't slack off.
Would not recommend. Had a very negative experience with her and could not wait to get out of her class. Avoid if possible

I highly recommend Professor Salinas! She made medieval literature so enjoyable and tied it into " real-life terms." She is a very thoughtful teacher and learns everyone's names. There is stuff to read for almost every class, but it's so doable. There is daily group discussion, but she will normally just call on people who want to speak.TAKE HER!!
Professor Salinas is extremely caring and understanding. Flexible assignments that aren't very difficult. I usually don't enjoy English classes but this one was great!

Ms. Salinas is a great prof, she is super down to earth and just wants you to participate. I think her workload is very reasonable besides all the papers that are required. In ENGL 104 the last project was an easy group video project, which was nice because dealing with finals was stressful. I recommened for any English class.

I took 104, and she is beyond amazing. She is a Graduate student so she understands what everyone is going through and is incredibly easy to work with for extended deadlines and help. The lectures are not long at all and are actually so helpful. There are very little papers and next to no homework. If you have the opportunity, TAKE THIS CLASS!!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I thought I had made the wrong decision of choosing an 8 am ENGL-104 class, but she made it worth it. Attendance is mandatory, but she is very understanding for excuses. She is an easy grader and makes class enjoyable. The way she designed due dates for assignments is very flexible for students and overall its an easy class to pass.

Ms. Salinas made this course very manageable, there were assignments due almost everyday because it was a summer course, but the course builds on itself which helps. Ms. Salinas provides good feedback, is understanding, and is an easy grader as long as you follow the instructions and rubrics.
